name: Prehistoric Pile Dwellings around the Alps
countries: Italy, France, Austria, Slovenia, Switzerland, Germany
description: This scattered collection of 111 small archaeological sites lies around the Alps, across Switzerland, Italy, Germany, France, Austria and Slovenia. Between about 5000 and 500 BC, farming communities built timber houses on stilts along lake shores and wetlands. Despite the popular image, they stood on marshy ground rather than open water. Rising lakes later submerged many of the surviving posts, which preserved remarkable traces of daily prehistoric life.
